meta.name: Children Of War
meta.description: Children of War is a movie based on the true events of the 1971 Genocide. Can we, in search of power, become animals? A genocide; neglected! The first use of rape as a weapon of war; undocumented! The lives of millions; unaccounted! The culprits; unpunished!
meta.slogan: Would you go to war for peace? A war child's search for acceptance and a nation inundated in blood.
